name: avatar
title: Avatar
purpose: Represent a person or entity through a resilient image with an accessible text fallback.
avoidFor: Clickable controls without a link or button
Status without a visible status explanation
accessibility: The root exposes one image role and accessible label.
The source image is decorative inside the labelled root.
Fallback text remains visible when the source is missing, delayed, or fails.
commonMistakes: Making the avatar itself interactive instead of wrapping it in a semantic control.
Using a fallback that does not identify the represented entity.
